resources.string: Shows the remaining time of an active focus session.
Safely restoring the previous device lock policy. FocusLock will retry automatically.
Detects when a selected app is opened during an active focus session and displays a blocking screen. It does not disable Home, Recents, or system emergency functions.

If you continue and enable Standard Protection, FocusLock uses Android Accessibility events to identify the package name of the app currently in the foreground and compare it with the apps you selected. During an active focus session, it displays a blocking overlay over a selected app. FocusLock does not retrieve window contents, read screen text, messages or passwords, capture screenshots, or transmit this information. Processing takes place locally on this device. This access is optional; you can cancel now or turn the service off at any time in Android Accessibility settings. Selected-app blocking will not work while the service is off.

FocusLock does not save notification content by default. Turn capture on here only if you consent, then grant Notification Access manually in Android Settings. Data stays on this device and can be deleted.
This is optional and separate from notification capture. Grant Notification Policy Access manually, then use the buttons to change Do Not Disturb explicitly. FocusLock never changes it automatically.

Phone and emergency access remain available. By default FocusLock does not reject calls; optional screening can reject unknown numbers only during an active focus session. Use the dial button to open the system dial pad.

When enabled, FocusLock helps protect your focus by screening incoming calls and rejecting numbers that are not on your allowed list during an active focus session. You can choose whether allowed numbers are exempt. If a number or saved data cannot be verified, the call is allowed. Emergency calls remain available; outgoing calls are not affected.
Call Screening role is unavailable on this device.
Automatic SMS replies — planned for a future release

Automatic replies to incoming text messages are not available in this version. We are reviewing the SMS permission requirements and app-store policies, and hope to make this feature available in a future release.
This list supplies allowed numbers when call screening is enabled and the Call Screening role is granted. Choosing a contact does not require broad contacts permission.
